### identity

#### account

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 520x160, selector `.account`).

Single account row — identicon, label and optional balance — the building block of account choosers and confirmation screens, in row or column layout with image, cashlink and editable-label variants.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| label | string | yes | - | The account's display label. Labels shaped like a valid Nimiq address render in Fira Mono uppercase (address-font). |
| address | string | no | - | User-friendly Nimiq address; a checksum-valid address renders its identicon (no identicon otherwise). |
| image | string | no | - | Image URL shown instead of the identicon (1rem radius); falls back to identicon/cashlink rendering on load error. |
| displayAsCashlink | boolean | no | false | Render the cashlink glyph (white link icon on a navy gradient circle with a 20% navy ring) instead of an identicon. |
| placeholder | string | no | - | Placeholder for the editable label input. |
| walletLabel | string | no | - | Secondary nq-label line under the label; column layout only. |
| balance | number | no | - | Balance in luna, rendered through Amount when set (0 included); omitted balances render no Amount. |
| decimals | number | no | 2 | Exact decimals for the balance Amount. |
| editable | boolean | no | - | Render the label as a LabelInput field (maxBytes 63); emits 'changed' with the new label. |
| layout | 'row' \| 'column' | no | row | 'row' (5.625rem identicon left, balance right, full width) or 'column' (stacked, 10rem identicon, centered label). |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: identicon, amount, label-input
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/Account.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue, vue-components:src/components/Amount.vue)

Notes: Sample state: layout 'row' at 420px (SmallPage width), label 'Main Account', address NQ11 MA1N ACC0 UNT0 0000 0000 0000 0000 001X (synthetic but checksum-valid, IBAN mod-97, verified against @nimiq/utils@0.12.4 ValidationUtils.isValidAddress), balance 1234567890 luna. (2026-07-10 fix: the previous sample spelled MAIN/ACCO with the letters I and O, which are not in the Nimiq base32 alphabet — 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVXY — so it failed validation despite the old note claiming checksum validity; replaced with 1/0 substitutions, check digits recomputed to the same NQ11, identicon re-snapped. Same fix as account-list.) Balance renders '12 345.68 NIM' (U+202F narrow no-break space grouping) because Account defaults decimals to 2 and passes it to Amount as EXACT decimals — unlike AccountList rows, which leave decimals unset and show min 2 / max 5. Identicon via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath pointed at the vendored iqons.min.svg (same recipe as the identicon component; sprite is the REAL team-shipped 84-symbol catalog at assets/img/iqons.min.svg, CDN fallback byte-identical). Static row state: label and balance at opacity 0.7, label fade-out mask on the right edge. Identicon.vue and Amount.vue scoped styles are inlined in truth/css (their markup is part of the row); the Vue port imports them plus LabelInput from the registry instead. Image/cashlink/column/editable/walletLabel variants carry full styles but are not in the pixel sample; the cashlink glyph svg is upstream's inline icon, kept verbatim in the Vue port. ValidationUtils.isValidAddress from @nimiq/utils@0.11.1 is inlined. Emits 'changed' (editable only); exposes focus().

#### account-details

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 500x640, selector `.account-details`).

Full account detail panel — large identicon, label, wallet label, balance and the full address in monospace chunks, with a top-right close button — shown when inspecting an account in Hub flows.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| address | String | yes | - | User-friendly Nimiq address; renders the identicon and the AddressDisplay chunks. |
| image | String | no | - | Optional image URL (e.g. a shop logo) shown instead of the identicon; falls back to the identicon if it fails to load. |
| label | String | no | - | Account label. If it equals the address, an empty label is rendered instead. |
| walletLabel | String | no | - | Wallet (account group) label shown under the account label as an uppercase nq-label. |
| balance | Number | no | - | Balance in luna; rendered through Amount with 2 decimals when set. |
| editable | Boolean | no | - | Render the label as a LabelInput field; changes are emitted as 'changed'. |
| placeholder | String | no | - | Placeholder for the editable label input. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: identicon, address-display, copyable, amount, close-button, label-input
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AccountDetails.vue, vue-components:src/components/Account.vue, vue-components:src/components/AddressDisplay.vue, vue-components:src/components/Copyable.vue, vue-components:src/components/CloseButton.vue, vue-components:src/components/Amount.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Sample state: address NQ33 DH76 PHUK J41Q LX3A U4E0 M0BM QJH9 QQL1 (the checksum-valid upstream storybook address), label 'Savings Account', walletLabel 'Keyguard Wallet', balance 2712415141213 luna -> '27 124 151.41' (Account passes its default decimals=2 to Amount; U+202F narrow no-break space grouping above 4 integer digits), editable=false, hosted in a 420x560 box (the storybook mounts it in a SmallPage). The panel is upstream's Account.vue in layout 'column' plus AddressDisplay(copyable) and CloseButton; their markup/styles are inlined since Account has no own registry entry. SCOPED-CSS SPECIFICITY TRAP: AccountDetails' '.account >>> .identicon' overrides (18rem identicon, 3rem label/balance, padding 0) share specificity (0,2,0) with Account.vue's '.column .identicon' rules and win only by source order — keep the AccountDetails block AFTER the Account block (runtime injects children on import, parent last). AddressDisplay renders its root AS a Copyable ('copyable address-display format-nimiq' on one element) because AccountDetails hardcodes copyable; resting state (tooltip/background at opacity 0). The Vue port wraps AddressDisplay's chunks in the registry Copyable instead (upstream merges both components onto one root; visually identical, but the flattened DOM differs there). Identicons via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath probing the vendored assets/img/iqons.min.svg first (same recipe as the identicon component). The image prop and editable/LabelInput path are ported in the Vue variant but not part of the pixel sample.

#### account-list

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x400, selector `.account-list`).

Selectable list of accounts — identicon + label + balance rows with hover caret — used as the account chooser in Hub flows (inside AccountSelector).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| accounts | AccountInfo[] | yes | - | Accounts to list: { userFriendlyAddress, label, balance (luna), walletId?, defaultLabel? }. |
| disabledAddresses | string[] | no |  | Addresses rendered disabled with an explanatory tooltip. |
| walletId | string | no | - | Fallback wallet id emitted with account-selected when the account has none. |
| editable | boolean | no | - | Render labels as LabelInput fields instead of selectable rows. |
| decimals | number | no | - | Exact decimals for the balance Amount (else min 2 / max 5). |
| minBalance | number | no | - | Balances render only when set; accounts below it are disabled (insufficient balance). |
| disableContracts | boolean | no | - | Disable contract entries (no path) with a tooltip. |
| disabled | boolean | no | - | Disable the whole list. |
| tooltipProps | object | no | - | Props forwarded to the disabled-row Tooltip. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: identicon, amount, tooltip, label-input
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AccountList.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Sample state: 3 enabled rows (Main Account 12 345.6789 NIM / Savings 2500.00 NIM / Pocket Money 49.92 NIM), minBalance set so balances render, list at 420px (SmallPage width). Addresses are synthetic but checksum-valid (IBAN mod-97), verified against @nimiq/utils@0.12.4 ValidationUtils.isValidAddress: NQ11 MA1N ACC0 UNT0 ... 001X, NQ46 SAV1 NGS0 ... 0002, NQ09 P0CK ETM0 NEY0 ... 0003. (2026-07-10 fix: the previous Main Account/Savings samples spelled MAIN/ACCO/SAVI with the letters I and O, which are not in the Nimiq base32 alphabet — 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVXY — so they failed validation despite the old note claiming checksum validity; replaced with 1/0 substitutions and freshly computed check digits, identicons re-snapped.) Identicons via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath pointed at iqons.min.svg (same recipe as the identicon component). Static state: identicon scale(0.9), label/balance opacity 0.7, caret hidden (appears on hover with green balance + row highlight). Amount formatting: U+202F narrow no-break space grouping above 4 integer digits. The row content is upstream's Account.vue (layout 'row'); its markup/styles are inlined in the Vue port since Account has no own registry entry. Tooltip/LabelInput only appear for disabled/editable rows (not in sample). Identicon sprite is the REAL team-shipped iqons.min.svg (84-symbol part catalog, 88KB) vendored at assets/img/iqons.min.svg — byte-identical to the Hub-deployed sprite captured in references/assets/hub/iqons.min.svg and to @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 dist; the snippet probes the local copy and falls back to the same CDN sprite, while the iqons JS library itself stays pinned on jsdelivr (code, not artwork).

#### account-ring

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 400x300, selector `.account-ring`).

Ring of up to 6 identicons representing a logged-in multi-address account set — hexagonally arranged identicons for filled slots, faint hexagon placeholders for empty ones.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| addresses | String[] | no | [] | Up to 6 user-friendly Nimiq addresses. The ring always renders 6 slots; slots beyond addresses.length show the identicon hexagon placeholder. |
| animate | Boolean | no | false | Staggered pop-in animation (500–750ms delays) for each filled identicon slot. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: identicon
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AccountRing.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Wraps the identicon component (same @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 jsdelivr pin in truth and demo). Sample state: 3 fixed valid addresses (NQ07 0000…, NQ21 1111…, NQ35 2222…) → 3 iqons + 3 faint placeholder hexagons. Default size 11.25rem = 90px under nimiq-style's 8px root. Bottom slot (nth-child 3) intentionally overflows the square container by ~0.45rem upstream; element screenshots crop to the .account-ring box identically in truth and demo. Identicon sprite is the REAL team-shipped iqons.min.svg (84-symbol part catalog, 88KB) vendored at assets/img/iqons.min.svg — byte-identical to the Hub-deployed sprite captured in references/assets/hub/iqons.min.svg and to @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 dist; the snippet probes the local copy and falls back to the same CDN sprite, while the iqons JS library itself stays pinned on jsdelivr (code, not artwork).

#### account-selector

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 500x480, selector `.account-selector`).

Account chooser across wallets — each wallet gets an uppercase label with a hairline rule, followed by its AccountList rows, in a 400px scroll container with fade masks and a 'Login to another account' footer.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| wallets | WalletInfo[] | yes | - | Wallets to list: { id, label, type (1 legacy / 2 BIP39 / 3 Ledger), accounts (Map or array of AccountInfo), contracts, btcXPub?, polygonAddresses? }. |
| disabledAddresses | string[] | no |  | Addresses rendered disabled, forwarded to each AccountList. |
| decimals | number | no | - | Exact decimals for the balance Amounts (else min 2 / max 5). |
| minBalance | number | no | - | Balances render only when set; wallets and accounts below it sort to the end. |
| disableContracts | boolean | no | - | Disable contract entries with a tooltip. |
| disableLegacyAccounts | boolean | no | - | Disable type-1 wallets; a tooltip on the wallet label explains why. |
| disableBip39Accounts | boolean | no | - | Disable type-2 wallets. |
| disableLedgerAccounts | boolean | no | - | Disable type-3 wallets. |
| highlightBitcoinAccounts | boolean | no | - | Show an orange BTC pill next to wallets with a btcXPub. |
| highlightUsdcAccounts | boolean | no | - | Show a blue USDC pill next to wallets with polygonAddresses. |
| allowLogin | boolean | no | true | Render the 'Login to another account' footer button (emits login). |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: account-list, identicon, tooltip
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AccountSelector.vue, vue-components:src/components/AccountList.vue, vue-components:src/components/Account.vue, vue-components:src/components/Amount.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Sample state: 2 wallets ('Keyguard Wallet': Primary Account 120.2311 NIM + HODL Account 27 124 151.41213 NIM; 'Ledger Wallet': My Ledger Account 98 765.4321 NIM + Pocket Money 2500.00 NIM), minBalance 1 so balances render, allowLogin true, no disabled wallets (so no Tooltip) and no BTC/USDC pills, at 420px width. Addresses are checksum-valid (story addresses + one synthetic); labels/amounts follow the account-list recipe (U+202F grouping above 4 integer digits, min 2 / max 5 decimals). The component is 400px tall (scoped height) with an overflow-y scroll container masked by a 4rem fade at top and bottom — the sample content overflows and clips at the fade, which is the real upstream behavior. CLASS COLLISION TRAP: AccountSelector's .wallet-label HEADER shares its class name with Account.vue's .wallet-label row rule; runtime scope attributes keep them apart, and the flattened CSS restores the same result only because the AccountSelector block comes AFTER the Account block (its margin shorthand wins by source order) — keep that order. The upstream wallets prop keys accounts in a JS Map; the Vue port accepts a Map or a plain array. wallets.length is greater than 1 here so headers render; a single enabled wallet drops its header and adds .extra-spacing to the container. Identicons via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr with Iqons.svgPath probing the vendored assets/img/iqons.min.svg first (same recipe as account-list).

#### address-display

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x400, selector `.address-display`).

Displays a Nimiq (or Ethereum) address as a grid of monospace chunks — 9 four-char blocks in 3 columns for Nimiq format — optionally copyable.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| address | string | yes | - | The address to display. |
| format | string | no | nimiq | 'nimiq' (9 chunks of 4, uppercase) or 'ethereum' (3 rows of 14 chars). |
| copyable | boolean | no | false | Wraps the display in a Copyable so clicking copies the address. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AddressDisplay.vue)

Notes: Sample state: NQ07 0000... burn address, nimiq format, copyable=false. HARDENED 2026-06-20: the 3×3 is now CSS Grid (grid-template-columns: repeat(3,33%) + justify-content:space-between) instead of flex width:33% — grid pins the column count so a wide fallback glyph can never reflow/wrap; the CSS self-imports Fira Mono so a missing font link can't make it drift; .chunk has white-space:nowrap. Pixel-verified 0% diff vs the original flex render, so the look is identical. GOTCHA still live: font-size:3rem + max-width:28.25rem assume the legacy 8px root; on a 16px-root modern page set them in px or 2× the rem. copyable=true depends on the Copyable component (not ported here). ValidationUtils.normalizeAddress from @nimiq/utils is inlined in the Vue port.

#### identicon

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 400x300, selector `.identicon`).

Nimiq identicon avatar — a deterministic hexagonal avatar generated from a Nimiq address via @nimiq/iqons; shows a hexagon placeholder for missing/invalid addresses.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| address | String | no | - | User-friendly Nimiq address (e.g. 'NQ07 0000 ...'). Invalid or missing addresses render the dark hexagon placeholder. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- npmDeps: @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Renders via @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 pinned on jsdelivr in both truth and demo; Iqons.svgPath must point at iqons.min.svg (the component normally resolves it via webpack file-loader). The generated data URL embeds a random clip-path id but is pixel-identical across runs. Upstream fixes width:10rem; sample state overrides to 128px at page level. ValidationUtils.normalizeAddress/isValidAddress from @nimiq/utils@0.11.1 are inlined in the Vue port. Identicon sprite is the REAL team-shipped iqons.min.svg (84-symbol part catalog, 88KB) vendored at assets/img/iqons.min.svg — byte-identical to the Hub-deployed sprite captured in references/assets/hub/iqons.min.svg and to @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 dist; the snippet probes the local copy and falls back to the same CDN sprite, while the iqons JS library itself stays pinned on jsdelivr (code, not artwork).

#### login-file

Category: identity. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 780x480, selector `.cards`).

Keyguard Login File — the downloadable account access card: white-framed card filled with the account color's bottom-right radial gradient, security-wave line pattern, key icon, NIMIQ wordmark, account label, rotated date line, rounded-module QR code of the encrypted secret and the 'Keep safe and confidential' footer. Drawn on canvas exactly like upstream, so the element doubles as the real, saveable Login File PNG.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| secret | String | yes | - | Base64 string encoded into the QR code. Upstream this is the encrypted entropy (56 bytes) plus an optional label suffix, base64-encoded (DownloadLoginFile.setEncryptedEntropy). |
| label | String | no | '<Color> Account' | Account label printed at the top of the card. Falls back to the upstream default '<Color> Account' for the active color. Truncated to 25 symbols with an ellipsis, like upstream. |
| color | String \| Number | no | 0 ('orange') | Account color: upstream LoginFileConfig index 0-9 or name ('orange' \| 'red' \| 'yellow' \| 'indigo' \| 'blue' \| 'purple' \| 'teal' \| 'pink' \| 'green' \| 'brown'). Upstream derives it from the first address via IqonHash.getBackgroundColorIndex. |
| date | String | no | today, YYYY-MM-DD | Date string printed rotated along the right edge. Upstream prints the creation day; pass a fixed value for deterministic output. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- npmDeps: qr-creator
- source: keyguard@02e7534 (keyguard:src/lib/LoginFile.js, keyguard:src/lib/LoginFileConfig.js, keyguard:src/lib/QrEncoder.js, keyguard:src/components/DownloadLoginFile.css, keyguard:src/translations/en.json)

Notes: Truth embeds upstream src/lib/LoginFile.js, LoginFileConfig.js and QrEncoder.js VERBATIM (keyguard@02e7534) and instantiates the class three times — the canonical color trio teal (index 6), blue (4), orange (0) — with deterministic sample secrets built exactly like DownloadLoginFile.setEncryptedEntropy (56 patterned bytes + label-length byte + utf8 label, base64). Card geometry all upstream: 630x1060 canvas, 24px outer white frame radius / 16px inner, 12px border, radial gradient anchored at the inner bottom-right corner with radius sqrt(606^2 + 1036^2) from corner to main color, waves at (12,12,606x576) with per-color opacity, key at (244,291,150x158), wordmark at (116,86,398x48), label centered at y 200 (600 36px, screen composite), rotated date at (606,725) with per-color opacity, footer at y 972, QR (radius 0.5, ecLevel M, white on transparent, 330px) at (150,548). Display size 40rem height mirrors DownloadLoginFile.css max-height. Two documented sample-state pins in the truth: Date is frozen to 2026-07-10 (upstream prints 'today', which would rot the committed reference.png) and LoginFile.FONT_FAMILY points at 'Mulish' (Google Fonts name of the same typeface keyguard self-hosts as legacy 'Muli'). The html variant re-renders the identical draw sequence with the published qr-creator@1.0.0 (same library keyguard vendors as lib/QrEncoder.js — the pixel diff doubles as proof of parity, same pin as the qr-code component). The three SVG artworks (waves, key, wordmark) are upstream's own data-URL strings copied byte-exact from LoginFile.js, not redrawn, so no separate assetFiles. The reserved signet+wordmark combination appears exactly as upstream ships it. Vue port exposes toDataUrl(), toObjectUrl() and filename() like upstream.

### layout

#### app-footer

Category: layout. Variants: vue, html. Verification: not pixel-verified (original brand composition, no upstream reference render).

Fleet app footer, two variants. FEATURED community variant (generalized from Andjroo's nimiq.school CommunityFooter): white 'Built by the community / for the community' band with the light-blue 'Visit nimiq.com' pill and a full-bleed honeycomb lattice of faint gray hexagons carrying four brand-colored community hexes (Nimiq Forum gold radial, Discord, Telegram, GitHub), over a navy radial strip with the app's own lockup, independent-project disclaimer, and optional quiet Status/Source/version line. Plus the original slim single-row 'Built on Nimiq' attribution footer (on-light and on-dark).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| community: appName | String | yes | - | AppFooterCommunity. The 'nimiq.appname' wordmark in the navy strip lockup (18px/800 white) and the GitHub hex aria-label. HTML variant: the .afc-brand-name span text. |
| community: githubHref | String | yes | - | AppFooterCommunity. The GitHub hex target: point it at the CONSUMING app's own repository, not nimiq's. HTML variant: the .afc-social--github href. |
| community: ctaLabel / ctaHref | String | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. The light-blue band pill; defaults 'Visit nimiq.com' -> https://nimiq.com. Sentence case, no period (rule 16). |
| community: forumHref / discordHref / telegramHref | String | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. The other three community hexes; defaults are the real links verified against live nimiq.com: forum.nimiq.community, discord.gg/nimiq, t.me/Nimiq. Do not invent replacements. |
| community slot: title | slot | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. Band title, default the two-line 'Built by the community<br>for the community'. Localizable; display title, so NO period and no em/en dashes. HTML variant: the .afc-title h2. |
| community slot: icon | slot | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. The lockup icon beside the wordmark (27px, rides currentColor at white-92%). Default = the Nimiq icon-set globe-with-check (nimiq--globe-filled + nimiq--check-thin, verbatim); swap in the app's own mark. Vue mints the check gradient id per instance; HTML variant ships id afc-check-grad, re-suffix it per instance if rendering several (rule 3). |
| community slot: disclaimer | slot | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. Navy-strip line, default 'An independent community project. Not affiliated with Team Nimiq.' Localizable body sentence: periods are correct HERE, never on the title. HTML variant: the .afc-line p. |
| community slot: links | slot | no | - | AppFooterCommunity. Optional quiet second line under the disclaimer: Status / Source anchors (white-50%, hover white, bold 600, never underlined, rule 21) and a version in <span class='afc-version'> (Fira Mono when loaded). HTML variant: the .afc-links nav, delete it if unused. |
| slim: dark | Boolean | no | - | AppFooter (slim). Default false (navy ink for grey/white page bodies). True switches the ink channel to white for navy app surfaces. HTML variant: add class 'on-dark' to the footer element. |
| slim: href | String | no | - | AppFooter (slim). Brand link target, default https://nimiq.com. Always rendered target=_blank rel=noopener. |
| slim slot: version | slot | no | - | AppFooter (slim). Optional version string (e.g. v1.4.2), rendered 12px in Fira Mono with a generic monospace fallback. Load Fira Mono only if you use this slot. HTML variant: the .af-version span, delete it if unused. |
| slim slot: links | slot | no | - | AppFooter (slim). Optional one or two dev links as plain <a> elements (Status, Source). Styled bold 600, sentence case, not underlined, 50% ink resting, full ink on hover (rule 21). HTML variant: the .af-links nav, delete it if unused. |

- source: original@null ()

Notes: ORIGINAL Nimiq-brand composition (not an upstream port), so verified:false with reference.png kept as a regression guard, the flag-hex precedent. REDESIGN DRIVER: Andjroo (2026-07-10) reviewed the v1 slim row: 'pretty basic... I would like to use something that looks a lot more like the actual brand footer. You can see it in my nimiq.school app.' The community variant is his nimiq.school CommunityFooter.vue (src/components/sections/CommunityFooter.vue) generalized for any fleet app; it is now the FEATURED variant and leads the demo; the slim row stays available unchanged as the minimal variant. THE FOUR FOOTERS, do not confuse them: (1) registry page-footer is the wallet card ACTION row (nq-card-footer, pins buttons at the bottom of a SmallPage); (2) the nimiq.com MARKETING footer is a heavy light surface (link columns, newsletter pill, honeycomb social band); (3) the FLEET COMMUNITY footer, this component's featured variant, is the flagship app-level closer: white community band + honeycomb + navy strip with the app's OWN lockup and independent-project disclaimer; (4) the slim 'Built on Nimiq' attribution row, this component's minimal variant, is fleet app CHROME (fleet evidence: swellet footer(), tipjar landing; 12 of 18 mini apps ship no footer at all). COMMUNITY VARIANT DECISIONS: (a) Honeycomb = the registry honeycomb-band TECHNIQUE (rounded flat-top hex as SVG data-URI mask) laid out as offset flex columns, taken verbatim from the reference including the 13-column LAYOUT, per-cell opacities (.13-.55, the organic fade of nimiq.com's bg-hexagons.svg whose 55 hexes range .01-.06), and the social placement: Discord+Telegram the ONE touching pair set diagonally, Forum mid-left, GitHub lower-right, all in center columns so they stay on-screen while faint cells bleed past both clipped edges (band overflow:hidden). Self-contained, no external asset, no JS. (b) Fully responsive via --w derived sizing (108px -> 92px @768 -> 80px @450): the SAME complete honeycomb shrinks on phones, never a flat row (the reference dropped an earlier absolute-positioned approach that scattered on desktop and collapsed on mobile). (c) Social glyphs are the REAL Nimiq icon-set mono logos (logos-{nimiq-forum,discord,telegram,github}-mono.svg) inlined verbatim, wrapper defs dropped so no SVG ids can collide; brand colors #5865f2/#2aabee/#24292f are third-party marks, exempt from the palette rule (nq lint SOCIAL set), and the Forum hex is the Nimiq gold bottom-right radial. (d) The demo lockup icon is the reference's globe-with-check (real Nimiq icon-set paths nimiq--globe-filled + nimiq--check-thin) verbatim, id namespaced afc-check-grad; the Vue SFC mints the id per instance via a module counter (rule 3). Consumers swap in their own mark via the icon slot. (e) Navy strip consumes var(--nimiq-blue-bg) with the bottom-right radial as an inline fallback plus background-color #1f2348 paint fallback, so it is rule-7 correct with or without nimiq-style loaded. (f) Two deliberate deltas from the reference CSS, both brand alignment: transitions use var(--nimiq-ease, cubic-bezier(0.25,0,0,1)) instead of plain 'ease' (skill motion spec), and .afc-title carries text-wrap:balance (nimiq.com applies balance to every heading; nq lint flags a multi-line heading without it; the title's <br> still forces the canonical two lines). (g) Copy rules: the title takes NO period and no em/en dashes; the disclaimer and any localized replacement are body sentences, so periods are correct there; CTA is a sentence-case light-blue pill. (h) The wordmark is 18px/800/-0.2px white per the reference; that weight is a LOCKUP spec, not heading typography (the lint faux-weight rule targets headings >=24px). (i) White-50% ink at 13.5px on navy is the fleet footer convention (nimiq.com itself ships sub-AA secondary text; lint warns, never gates). (j) nq lint on the demo: 0 errors, one advisory warning category (off-scale spacing: 54/21/28/44/116px). Those values are the reference's own component-intrinsic geometry (54px = the honeycomb half-pitch offset, 116px = column pitch, 21px pill padding, 28px title margin, 44px navy strip padding), verbatim from nimiq.school; the spacing scale targets page layout rhythm, so they are accepted, not fixed. SLIM VARIANT (unchanged from v1): one ink channel --af-ink (navy / .on-dark white), everything rests at rgba(ink,.5) and hovers to rgb(ink); horizontal mono logo VERBATIM from assets/logos/nimiq-icons-logos/logos-nimiq-horizontal-mono.svg with the two-identical-stop currentColor gradient flattened to fill=currentColor (pixel-identical, kills the gradient-id footgun); static flow only, never position:fixed; margin-top:auto pins to a flex-column page bottom; both variants pad the bottom with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for iOS PWAs. Vue gotcha: consumer content in the links/icon slots needs :slotted() in scoped CSS; both SFCs ship those selectors. VERIFY: canonical target is the .af-demo wrapper (unique, Playwright strict mode) at 1200px, so reference.png guards all three renders: community variant full-width with the sample nimiq.example lockup, then the slim variant with all slots filled on the #F8F8F8 stage, then the on-dark minimal form on the navy radial stage. Keep truth/demo/snippet markup identical.

#### app-header

Category: layout. Variants: vue, html. Verification: not pixel-verified (original brand composition, no upstream reference render).

The fleet's brand bar in navy and light: a custom per-app brand (hexagon-family icon + the app's own wordmark, the nimiq.school 'Nimiq.school' style) with a built-in flag-hex language selector, an optional network badge and a tools slot for the connect-wallet-pill. The plain horizontal-white Nimiq logo stays as the fallback brand. Replaces the header block 15 apps hand-roll per page.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| appName | String | no | undefined | Custom brand mode, the DEFAULT for fleet apps (Andjroo, 2026-07-10): the #icon slot (or the universal hexagon) + this name in the 'Nimiq.school' wordmark style (17px/700, no tracking). Omit for the fallback horizontal-white Nimiq logo. Never combine any icon with that logo (rule 4). |
| slot: icon | slot (Vue) / markup (html) | no | - | The app's own hexagon-family brand icon, 24px, drawn in currentColor so it reads navy on light and white on navy (class app-header-icon). Namespace its gradient/clip ids per instance (rule 3). The demo carries the nimiq.school globe-with-check verbatim; the universal hexagon is the default. |
| variant | 'navy' \| 'light' | no | 'navy' | Surface. navy = the radial --nimiq-blue-bg bar (rule 7). light = the nimiq.school bar: #FAFAFA, hairline box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(31,35,72,.08) instead of a border, navy ink; works sticky (host sets position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50). html variant: add class app-header--light. |
| languages | { id, name, flagUrl, fit? }[] | no | - | The built-in language selector (the nimiq.school NavBar pattern): the button shows ONLY the current language's flag-hex + a small caret; the dropdown lists flag + native name. Flags are vendored flag-icons files per the flag-hex precedent (fit pans/zooms per flag, e.g. us { aspect: 4/3 }); never a flag CDN. html variant: author the trigger + list markup and wire it with initLanguageMenu (app-header.js). |
| language | String | no | - | Current language id, v-model:language compatible (pairs with the update:language emit; change fires too). html driver: 'change' CustomEvent (detail = id) + onChange callback. |
| badge | String | no | undefined | Network badge text (e.g. 'Testnet', 'Demo'), the wallet's testnet treatment: orange uppercase label on a white .07 chip (navy .07, the nq-button-s rest surface, on the light bar). Omit to hide. |
| href | String | no | '/' | Brand link target. |
| slot: brand | slot (Vue) / markup (html) | no | - | Replaces the whole brand link. Default renders the custom brand (or the fallback logo). |
| slot: tools | slot (Vue) / markup (html) | no | - | Right-side cluster after the badge and language selector; the intended mount for connect-wallet-pill (class on-dark / variant dark on navy). Without badge, languages and tools the brand centers itself (the tipjar layout). |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: flag-hex
- source: original@null ()

Notes: ORIGINAL composition (flag-hex precedent), so verified:false; reference.png is still snapped from truth/truth.html and nq verify guards the demo against it as a regression check. v2, redesigned 2026-07-10 on Andjroo's direct feedback: 'All my app headers should have the language selector. The testnet/mainnet indicator is okay. All of them will have a custom logo... they'll say nimiq dot their app name and then they'll have the custom logo.' The flagship reference is nimiq.school (NavBar.vue + CommunityFooter.vue). Design decisions: (1) CUSTOM PER-APP BRAND IS THE DEFAULT: a 24px hexagon-family icon slot in currentColor + the app wordmark at 17px/700 with normal tracking (NavBar .nav-brand-name verbatim; v1 had 16px). The demo icon is the nimiq.school globe-with-check verbatim from CommunityFooter.vue (real Nimiq icon-set paths: nimiq--globe-filled + nimiq--check-thin; the green check gradient and its knockout ring kept exactly as shipped, ring fill set per surface so the knockout matches the bar; gradient ids namespaced nq-ah-check-<instance> per rule 3). The horizontal-white Nimiq logo is DEMOTED to the fallback brand for pages with no identity of their own; it keeps working (kept in demo, last) and still must never receive a second icon (rule 4). (2) TWO SURFACES: navy stays the v1 bar (radial --nimiq-blue-bg anchor bottom right per rule 7, 16px 20px padding); light is the nimiq.school NavBar surface verbatim: #FAFAFA, hairline box-shadow 0 1px 0 rgba(31,35,72,.08) (never a border), navy ink, sticky-safe. (3) BUILT-IN LANGUAGE SELECTOR, the NavBar pattern verbatim: trigger = current flag ONLY (24x22 flag-hex) + 10x6 caret, 38px/radius-8 ghost button (hover rgba(31,35,72,.06) on light per NavBar, white .07 on navy, the wallet testnet chip surface); dropdown = 220px white card, radius 10, shadow 0 4px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16) (NavBar verbatim), options 14px/600 flag + NATIVE name, current in #0582CA (blue text on the white card, fine under rule 20). ARIA per the spec: aria-haspopup=listbox + aria-expanded on the trigger, role=listbox/option + aria-selected, outside-click + Escape close, everything tabbable with the house :focus-visible rings (#0582CA on light, #0CA6FE on navy per rule 20). Arrow-key roving is NOT carried: the flagship NavBar has none and options are real buttons on the tab order (radical simplicity). Closed headers may omit the list from the DOM entirely (the NavBar v-if pattern; the demo's closed instances do). (4) FLAGS are vendored artwork per the flag-hex precedent, never a CDN: the demo inlines exactly-drawable civil flag designs (de, fr, it, nl, jp rects/circle) inside the verbatim hexagon clip with the one gray fh-edge; real apps point <image href> at their vendored flag-icons files or pass flagUrl to FlagHex (Vue, dependsOn flag-hex; fit pans/zooms per flag, us { aspect: 4/3 } etc). (5) HTML DRIVER app-header.js (initLanguageMenu), the connect-wallet-pill driver precedent: dependency-free ES module, markup owns the languages, driver wires open/close/selection, re-suffixes cloned flag ids (rule 3) when swapping the trigger flag, dispatches 'change' (detail = id) + onChange. (6) BADGE unchanged (wallet Sidebar.vue .testnet-notice, orange = warning); on light the chip is rgba(31,35,72,.07), the shipped nq-button-s rest surface, because white .07 vanishes on #FAFAFA. nq lint reports the badge as a colored-uppercase warning; accepted deliberately with the upstream citation. nq lint's only other demo warning is off-scale spacing (10px brand gap, 7px option padding, 20px side padding): those values are the flagship NavBar and the v1 tipjar bar verbatim, kept over snapping to the scale so the header matches the shipped sites pixel for pixel. (7) MOBILE: safe-area insets kept; the bar is a container (container-type inline-size) so the wordmark yields below 420px when the tools cluster is full (2+ tools, :has probe) and spacing tightens one step; both the bar and the tools cluster flex-wrap instead of overflowing below that. Proven by the 360px demo instance (single row: icon + badge + lang + pill). (8) IDENTICON-BEARING pill states in the demos stay idle; the connected chip lives in connect-wallet-pill's own restaged demo. (9) No new colors, no ornament; the one calculated break stays the brand icon's gold/green accent. Fleet refs: nimiq.school NavBar.vue + CommunityFooter.vue (flagship), tipjar public/index.html .header, splitlink public/index.html .app-header, wallet Sidebar.vue testnet-notice. Pairs with connect-wallet-pill (mounted in the tools slot; its restaged demo mounts inside THIS header).

#### bottom-overlay

Category: layout. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 1000x300, selector `.bottom-overlay-stage`).

Dismissible notification bar pinned to the bottom center of the viewport — rounded, shadowed, in dark, light or green theme, with an optional close button — used by the wallet for status and update notices.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| theme | String | no | dark | 'dark' (nimiq-blue on white text), 'light' (white on nimiq-blue text) or 'green' (nimiq-green). Dark and green use the inverse close button. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: close-button
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/BottomOverlay.vue, vue-components:src/components/CloseButton.vue)

Notes: Sample state: theme 'dark' (default), close listener bound (upstream watches $listeners.close, so .has-close-button + CloseButton appear; the Vue 3 port checks attrs.onClose), slot text from the upstream storybook. POSITIONING TRAP: the overlay is position:fixed (left 50%, bottom 2rem, translateX(-50%)) — normally viewport-anchored. Truth/demo pin it inside a fixed-size stage (.bottom-overlay-stage, 720x220) whose transform makes it the containing block for fixed descendants, so verify captures the anchored bottom-center state deterministically; the verify selector is the STAGE, not the overlay, because cropping the overlay alone would not prove the anchoring. In a 720px containing block the shrink-to-fit width is capped at half the box (available space right of left:50%), so the sample text wraps to two lines — real upstream behavior for narrow containers. Media queries at 912px (full-width minus margins) and 450px (flush bottom sheet) are viewport-based; the 1000px verify viewport keeps the desktop state. The gradients principle flag is false-by-design faithful to upstream: the dark theme is the flat var(--nimiq-blue), not the radial nq-blue-bg. CloseButton scoped CSS compiles to button[data-v-x] upstream — the truth keeps the attribute so its (0,1,1) specificity beats .nq-button-s (0,1,0) for height 3rem; the html variant gets the same result from .bottom-overlay .close-button (0,2,0). Upstream emits 'close' on click; the html snippet removes the bar.

#### carousel

Category: layout. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 700x400, selector `.carousel`).

3D slide carousel — entries sit on a circle in perspective, the selected one faces front and the rest recede; click, arrow keys or the selected prop rotate the ring (used by the Keyguard for account and word choices).

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| entries | string[] | yes | - | Slide names; each names a slot that provides that slide's content. |
| selected | String | no | - | Entry name to bring to the front. Invalid or missing values fall back to the first entry. |
| entryMargin | Number | no | 16 | Minimum gap in px between neighboring slides; sets the ring radius together with the slide widths. |
| animationDuration | Number | no | 1000 | Tween duration in ms for radius and rotation changes. |
| hideBackgroundEntries | Boolean | no | false | display:none for entries on the back half of the circle. |
| disabled | Boolean | no | false | Blocks interaction and rotates all non-selected entries to the hidden back position. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/Carousel.vue)

Notes: Sample state: 3 slides ('Card 1/2/3' as fixed 200x240 nq-cards), middle selected, entryMargin 16 (default), settled (no tween running). JS-MEASURED GEOMETRY TRAP: upstream positions every slide from JS — it measures slide offsetWidth/offsetHeight, derives radius = (maxNeighborDistance/2)/sin(pi/entryCount), tweens per-entry rotations (Tweenable from @nimiq/utils), and writes transform/z-index/min-height into element.style each animation frame. The html variant freezes those exact styles inline (values documented in truth.html); it is a static snapshot — changing selection/rotation needs the Vue variant, where the full Tweenable loop is ported (Tweenable itself is inlined verbatim, so no npm dep). Slides must have a fixed size for the frozen numbers to hold; resizing slides or margins means recomputing x=sin(r)*radius, z=cos(r)*radius-radius per entry. z-index is assigned by ascending z (stable sort), NOT transform-style:preserve-3d — upstream avoids preserve-3d because it breaks clickability. With 1 or 2 entries upstream adds a dummy circle position so the second entry is not hidden exactly behind the first. The 1500px perspective on the container projects the z=-187.06 side cards to ~89% scale. Keyboard: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight rotate (ignored while an input/textarea has focus, while disabled, or before the previous tween is half done).

#### corner-control

Category: layout. Variants: vue, html. Verification: not pixel-verified (original brand composition, no upstream reference render).

The fleet's one-button header corner: wallet state on the face (connect-wallet-pill + caret), everything else in one menu — mini wallet (rename, balance in NIM + reference fiat, Receive/Send/scan per the wallet's MobileActionBar), receive view with QR + tap-to-copy address, language picker, reference-currency picker, opt-in Create-a-Cashlink, Open in Nimiq Pay, testnet-only network row, quiet Disconnect. Replaces the divergent per-app connect + language chrome across the fleet.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| connect | async () => ({ address, label?, balanceNim?, identiconUrl? } \| null) | no | - | HubApi.chooseAddress via the nimiq-app-shell createWallet seam. Resolve null on cancel. Unwired, the Connect button shows a translated handoff bubble instead of sitting dead. |
| onboard | () => void | no | - | HubApi.onboard — the 'New to Nimiq? Create a wallet' line under Connect. The wallet-acquisition funnel: a visitor with no wallet creates one right in the popup. |
| onDisconnect | () => void | no | - | Forget the LOCAL connection. NEVER wire Hub logout here — logout removes the account from the wallet itself. |
| rename | (label) => void | no | - | HubApi.rename (RequestType.RENAME, hub/client/HubApi.ts:291). The label is stored IN THE WALLET, so a rename made in one app follows the user across every nimiq.* app. Hidden in mini-app mode (window.nimiq has no rename). |
| send / scan / createCashlink | () => void | no | - | HubApi.checkout, the qr-scanner component, HubApi.createCashlink ('Create a Cashlink' — the wallet's exact SendModal string, official .po translations included). Cashlink row renders only with cashlink: true (opt-in per app: tips/party/cards/kids yes, POS no). |
| cashlink / testnet | boolean = false | no | - | testnet renders the network row + badge; on MAINNET the network says nothing and the lone Disconnect centers itself. |
| language / defaultFiat / rates | string = 'en' / string = 'USD' / { USD: nimPrice, ... } | no | - | Balance is ALWAYS 'NIM (bold navy) over fiat (gray)' — the wallet's AddressOverview stack, right-aligned. The currency grid is fiat-only (NIM is never a mode). rates comes from the app's fiat feed; formatting via Intl.NumberFormat. |
| i18n / languages / currencies | overrides / [{ id, name, flag }] / [{ ticker, flag }] | no | - | Picking a language re-words the WHOLE menu live (data-i18n swap). 10-language table ships in the driver; language rows use nimiq.school order + flag choices (Spanish rides MX). |
| isMiniApp / renderQr / openPay | boolean override / (canvas, uri) => void / () => void | no | - | Mini-app default detection = !!window.nimiqPay (injected pre-script by Nimiq Pay). QR default = window.QrCreator (qr-creator@1.0.0, the qr-code component's pinned lib). openPay default = nimiqpay://miniapp?url=<encoded> deeplink. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: connect-wallet-pill, flag-hex, qr-code
- npmDeps: qr-creator, @nimiq/iqons, @nimiq/hub-api
- assetFiles: img/flags-square/flag-US.svg, img/flags-square/flag-MX.svg, img/flags-square/flag-DE.svg, img/flags-square/flag-IN.svg, img/flags-square/flag-CN.svg, img/flags-square/flag-FR.svg, img/flags-square/flag-TR.svg, img/flags-square/flag-KR.svg, img/flags-square/flag-BR.svg, img/flags-square/flag-VN.svg, img/flags-square/flag-EU.svg, img/flags-square/flag-GB.svg, img/flags-square/flag-JP.svg, img/flags-square/flag-CH.svg, img/flags-square/flag-CA.svg, img/flags-square/flag-AU.svg

Notes: SPEC LOCKED with Andjroo 2026-07-23 (memory: nimiq-corner-control-2026-07-23). Sources, all verbatim upstream: actions row = wallet/src/components/MobileActionBar.vue (Receive nq-button-s quiet LEFT w/ arrow-right-small rotated 90deg=down; Send nq-button-pill light-blue RIGHT rotated -90deg=up; bare ScanQrCodeIcon at opacity .4, padding 4px, from nimiq-style/src/icons/scan-qr-code.svg). Copy = vue-components Copyable verbatim: light-blue radial tooltip 800ms w/ 0.2s delay + curved mask tail (scaleY(-1) when tooltip sits above), copied/hover field rgba(5,130,202,.08) + #0582CA text, and the blue HOLDS until blur (upstream colors on :focus; cc-copied-hold mirrors it for browsers that don't focus buttons on click). Balance = AddressOverview stack: name left (600), NIM bold 13/700 over gray fiat 12/600 right-aligned; NIM thin-space grouped; NIM always shown, currency grid is fiat-only w/ USD default (the wallet Settings reference-currency selector, circles -> flag-hex hexagons). Address lives BEHIND Receive (wallet pattern): back row, real QR (qr-creator, nimiq: URI, radius .5, fill #1F2348), 3x3 Fira Mono grid. Rename = tap the name -> inline input (inset box-shadow border, rule 1; no pencil icon — neither nimiq-style nor vue-components ships one, rule 15). 'Create a Cashlink' = the wallet's exact SendModal.vue string; official .po translations for de/es/fr/zh/pt. Flags = wallet square flag files clipped by flag-hex, per-flag FLAG_FIT (KR 0.84 + white hex underlay, the nimiq.school precedent); the official 422-hexagon nimiq-flags set (assets/icons/nimiq-flags.json) is a possible future swap. Mini-app mode: window.nimiqPay is injected pre-script; face collapses to flag-only, wallet/cashlink/openpay/disconnect hidden, language preset from nimiqPay.language. TRAPS baked into the CSS/JS: (1) standard scrollbar-width/scrollbar-color live in a Firefox-only @supports (-moz-appearance:none) block — unprefixed they make Chrome 121+ ignore ::-webkit-scrollbar and the gutter slider vanishes; (2) every svg copied at runtime gets fresh gradient/clipPath ids (rule 3) or url(#id) resolves into display:none defs and icons half-paint; (3) demo/consumer pages MUST open with <meta charset="utf-8"> or non-ASCII language names mojibake on file://. Invisible Hub seams deliberately NOT in the UI: signMessage (sign-in with Nimiq) and list() (silent label refresh after fleet-wide renames; third-party storage caveat). Hub logout is NOT Disconnect. Demo/truth: identicon pre-rendered with @nimiq/iqons 1.6.0, QR pre-rendered with qr-creator@1.0.0 for a deterministic reference; ORIGINAL composition (no upstream equivalent) so verified stays false with the self-render reference.png as regression guard, the flag-hex precedent. PRODUCTION TRUTH (2026-07-24): the shipped implementation is nimiq-app-shell v0.4.0 mountCornerControl (.nq-cc-* namespace) — this registry component is the DESIGN REFERENCE; port deltas from the shell when re-staging. Production evolved past the locked mock in Andjroo's live phone reviews: (1) SEND VIEW — the menu is a real mini wallet: recipient (Nimiq-base32 validated) + amount (<= known balance) collected in-menu, then Wallet.pay(); hub mode rides the Hub CHECKOUT popup which signs AND broadcasts itself (verified: hub CheckoutTransmission.vue calls client.sendTransaction — plain signTransaction does NOT broadcast), sender pinned via forceSender; mini-app mode uses the host wallet's native send. (2) Hub 3rd-party whitelist (hub RpcApi): checkout/signTransaction/signStaking/signMessage/chooseAddress/ createCashlink/manageCashlink/connectAccount ONLY — onboard and rename are origin-PRIVILEGED, so the 'New to Nimiq?' line calls chooseAddress (its Hub view auto-onboards a zero-wallet visitor) and rename is LOCAL-first (localStorage per address; onRename = optional extra sync hook). (3) Hub connection PERSISTS across reloads (address+label in localStorage). (4) The menu stays a 272px corner-anchored card at EVERY viewport — the full-width phone sheet was rejected. (5) fmtFiat grows decimals until within 10% of the true value (wallet FiatAmount maxRelativeDeviation) — sub-cent NIM balances never floor to $0.00. (6) Action rows close the menu before their handoff. (7) Balance shows LIQUID NIM only (RPC account balance); staked NIM needs a getStaker RPC — tracked in nimiq.kids#82.

### payment

#### amount

Category: payment. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x400, selector `.amount`).

Formats a crypto amount given in its smallest unit (luna, satoshi, ...) as a human-readable number with thin-space digit grouping, configurable decimals and a currency ticker.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| amount | number \| bigint \| BigInteger | yes | - | Amount in the currency's smallest unit (e.g. luna for NIM). |
| decimals | number | no | - | Exact decimals to show; takes precedence over minDecimals/maxDecimals. |
| minDecimals | number | no | 2 | Minimum decimals to show (pads with zeros). |
| maxDecimals | number | no | 5 | Maximum decimals to show (rounds). |
| showApprox | boolean | no | false | Prefix '~ ' when rounding made the displayed value inexact. |
| currency | string | no | nim | Currency code; rendered uppercase as the ticker (special-cased: tnim→tNIM, mbtc→mBTC, tbtc→tBTC, usdc.e→USDC.e). |
| currencyDecimals | number | no | 5 | Decimals of the currency's smallest unit (5 for NIM/luna, 8 for BTC/sat). |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/Amount.vue)

Notes: Sample state: 1234567890 luna = 12,345.6789 NIM, minDecimals 2, maxDecimals 5, currency nim. FormattableNumber from @nimiq/utils is inlined as a faithful mini-port in the Vue variant (string-based, precision-loss-free: moveDecimalSeparator, half-up rounding, U+202F narrow no-break space grouping applied only when there are more than 4 integer digits). No npm deps. The .currency span carries the currency code as a class for host styling; upstream itself styles only .amount (nowrap) and .approx::before.

#### amount-with-fee

Category: payment. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x400, selector `.amount-with-fee`).

Large centered amount entry field (auto-sizing AmountInput with currency ticker) plus a secondary line that shows either an 'Insufficient balance' error, an approximate fiat value and/or the network fee. Used in send-transaction flows.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| value | { amount: number, fee: number, isValid: boolean } | no | { amount: 0, fee: 0, isValid: false } | v-model object: amount and fee in the currency's smallest unit (luna); isValid is computed and emitted back (amount > 0 && amount + fee <= availableBalance). |
| availableBalance | number | no | 0 | Spendable balance in the smallest unit; entering more shows the insufficient-balance error and red styling. |
| fiatAmount | number \| null | no | - | Optional fiat value of the entered amount; shown as '~<FiatAmount>' when set together with fiatCurrency. |
| fiatCurrency | string \| null | no | - | Fiat currency code for fiatAmount (e.g. 'eur'). |
| currency | string | no | nim | Crypto currency code; rendered uppercase as the ticker (special-cased: tnim→tNIM, mbtc→mBTC, tbtc→tBTC, usdc.e→USDC.e). |
| currencyDecimals | number | no | 5 | Decimals of the currency's smallest unit (5 for NIM/luna, 8 for BTC/sat). |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: amount, fiat-amount
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/AmountWithFee.vue, vue-components:src/components/AmountInput.vue)

Notes: Sample state: amount 10000000 luna (input shows '100'), fee 0, availableBalance 50000000, no fiat — valid, so the fee-section renders empty (min-height 2rem placeholder). Both truth and demo replicate AmountInput's JS width behavior: the input's inline width is set to the rendered width of a hidden measuring span (text + 1.25rem padding) after fonts load; the upstream font-shrink logic (maxFontSize) only kicks in for values wider than the container and is not exercised by the sample. The slot/error/fiat/fee branches are documented in the snippet. Vue port ships AmountWithFee.vue + AmountInput.vue (AmountInput is not a standalone registry component); Amount.vue and FiatAmount.vue are imported from sibling registry components 'amount' and 'fiat-amount' (copy them next to AmountWithFee.vue, see dependsOn). $t is stubbed as identity.

#### fiat-amount

Category: payment. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x400, selector `.fiat-amount`).

Displays a fiat amount with an optimized currency symbol (e.g. $1234.56 instead of USD 1234.56) and adaptive decimal precision: decimals are extended until the rounded display deviates from the true amount by at most maxRelativeDeviation.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| amount | number | yes | - | The fiat amount to display. |
| currency | string | yes | - | ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. 'USD', 'EUR'. |
| maxRelativeDeviation | number | no | 0.1 | Max allowed relative deviation of the rounded display value; decimals extend until met. |
| locale | string | no | - | Formatting locale, e.g. 'en-US'. Defaults to a locale typical for the currency. |
| hideDecimals | boolean | no | false | Render without decimals. Takes precedence over maxRelativeDeviation. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/FiatAmount.vue)

Notes: Sample state: amount=1234.56, currency='USD', locale='en-US' (hardcoded so the render is machine-independent) -> '$1234.56'. The upstream component has NO <style> block; the span inherits font/color from the page (nimiq-style body text). CurrencyInfo and FormattableNumber from @nimiq/utils are inlined in the Vue port (symbol + decimals resolution incl. EXTRA_SYMBOLS/decimal-less lists, and integer grouping with narrow no-break space for >4 integer digits).

#### payment-info-line

Category: payment. Variants: vue, html. Verification: pixel-verified, max diff 0.5% (viewport 600x300, selector `.payment-info-line`).

Checkout header line: crypto amount (with optional fiat value + price-breakdown tooltip) on the left, an animated arrow runway, the recipient (shop logo or identicon + origin domain) and an expiry countdown timer on the right. Used at the top of the Nimiq Hub checkout.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cryptoAmount | { amount: number \| bigint \| BigInteger, currency: string, decimals: number } | yes | - | Amount to pay in the currency's smallest unit, with the currency code and its decimals (e.g. 5 for NIM). |
| fiatAmount | { amount: number, currency: string } | no | - | Optional fiat value (base unit, e.g. Euro). When set, a fiat line is shown under the crypto amount with a price-breakdown tooltip on hover/click. |
| fiatApiProvider | 'CoinGecko' \| 'CryptoCompare' | no | CoinGecko | Fiat API used to fetch the reference exchange rate for rate-deviation warnings. |
| vendorMarkup | number | no | - | Vendor crypto markup (>= -1) as a fraction, e.g. .05 for +5%; shown in the price-breakdown tooltip. |
| networkFee | number \| bigint \| BigInteger | no | - | Suggested network fee in the smallest unit; shown in the price-breakdown tooltip. |
| origin | string | yes | - | Origin URL of the shop; the part after '://' is shown as the recipient label. |
| address | string | no | - | Recipient address; renders an Identicon when it is a valid Nimiq address and no shopLogoUrl is given. |
| shopLogoUrl | string | no | - | Shop logo image; takes precedence over the identicon. |
| startTime | number | no | - | Timestamp when the payment request was created; together with endTime enables the countdown timer. |
| endTime | number | no | - | Timestamp when the payment request expires. |
| theme | 'normal' \| 'inverse' | no | normal | 'inverse' renders white text/icons for dark backgrounds. |

- cssFiles: css/legacy/nimiq-style.min.css
- dependsOn: amount, fiat-amount, tooltip, identicon
- npmDeps: @nimiq/utils, @nimiq/iqons
- assetFiles: img/iqons.min.svg
- source: vue-components@3c5b972 (vue-components:src/components/PaymentInfoLine.vue, vue-components:src/components/Timer.vue, vue-components:src/components/Identicon.vue)

Notes: Sample state: 199.6 NIM (19960000 luna) / 2.99 EUR to shop.nimiq.com (identicon for burn address NQ07 0000..., pinned @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 CDN), timer frozen at 10 of 15 minutes left (progress 1/3, countdown '10', circle dash values hand-computed for radius 12, fullCircleLength 2π·12). Tooltips closed; arrow-runway arrow rests at opacity 0 (screenshots disable the infinite animation). The .payment-info-line wrapper is the 420px SmallPage width; upstream root class is .info-line. Cascade quirk reproduced from upstream: Account's '.row .label:not(.editable)' (specificity 0,4,0) beats PaymentInfoLine's deep '.account .label' padding-left .75rem, so the label padding is effectively 1rem; ties (font-weight/mask-image/identicon size) go to PaymentInfoLine via injection order — the snippet CSS preserves this rule order, don't reorder. Vue port ships PaymentInfoLine.vue + minimal inline Account.vue (no editable/cashlink) and Timer.vue (radius snaps instead of tweening, simplified update interval); Amount.vue, FiatAmount.vue, Tooltip.vue, Identicon.vue come from sibling registry components (see dependsOn). getExchangeRates (rate-deviation warning) uses the real @nimiq/utils npm package; failures just suppress the warning. $t stubbed as identity; upstream's :container="$parent" became a container prop. Identicon sprite is the REAL team-shipped iqons.min.svg (84-symbol part catalog, 88KB) vendored at assets/img/iqons.min.svg — byte-identical to the Hub-deployed sprite captured in references/assets/hub/iqons.min.svg and to @nimiq/iqons@1.6.0 dist; the snippet probes the local copy and falls back to the same CDN sprite, while the iqons JS library itself stays pinned on jsdelivr (code, not artwork).
